fields.statement: QA: scratch build of the branch (go build -trimpath, outside PATH) with a fake claude and fake rex in an isolated HOME. rhiza skill check "/rhiza-builder good {leaf}" --permission-mode manual: 3 of 3 gates pass, exit 0; bare (no trailers): fail trailers by name, exit 1; quiet (no session done): fail session-done, exit 1; crashing builder: 0 of 3, exit 1; --json equals rhiza api call skill.check output; uninstalled /rhiza-nosuch refused naming rhiza guide install --agent claude; empty invoke, --role planner, --dry-run, missing --permission-mode, bypassPermissions and an unknown agent refused; TMPDIR inside a git repo refused; leaked RHIZA_ROOT/RHIZA_CHANGE/RHIZA_ACTOR ignored; user repo git status and .rhiza/log unchanged, scratch removed unless --keep. Defect: a failing builder is retried up to 3 attempts, and a fixture verifier session launches after each attempt; only attempt 1 is graded (finding recorded).

QA: scratch build with fakes. --role verifier: good passes 3 of 3, exit 0, no builder session launched; one writing no Evidence fails evidence (and session-done) by name, exit 1; crashing verifier fails, exit 1. --role check: good records a round and passes 3 of 3; bare and crashing checks fail findings by name, exit 1 (re-run for 3 cycles, as designed). --keep names a scratch repo outside the current repo; the user repo is unchanged after every case. TestScripts skill-check-roles passes.

QA: rhiza workflow check on a hand-written build -> test -> merge (rhiza ship merge) warns naming merge and the path build -> test -> merge, in text and --json, exit 0 and valid true; a merge (multi-line run with gh pr merge) reached only via a kind=gate step: no warning; echo "rhiza ship merged" is not taken for a merge; ship-change: none. Defect: built-in plan, plan-milestone, plan-review and ship-change-classic, whose merge follows a command step running rhiza run gate or rhiza ship gate, get the warning (finding recorded).

QA: test on.fail = "build" back to agent step build warns naming step, outcome, target and handback:build, in text and --json, exit 0; on.fail = "handback:build": no warning; ship-change and a fresh rhiza workflow new: no loop warning (only the placeholder one). Rough edge: merge on.fail = "test" where test routes on.fail = "handback:build" still warns although the hand-back is counted (minor finding).

QA: rhiza workflow check on a workflow with an agent step /nosuch-skill and a leaves builder /rhiza-nosuchbuilder warns for each, naming step, role and command, exit 0, valid true; with HOME skills removed, the /rhiza-verifier role also warns and adds run rhiza guide install --agent claude; a repo-local .claude/skills/nosuch-skill clears its warning; installed skills give none.
